summary: Iteration 62 — My Products shelf (/products), merged KR list, KR-context handoff (?kr=), audiobook + youtube-assets. Backend 7/7 pass. Frontend end-to-end verified after fixing a CRITICAL duplicate /products route in App.js that had made the new ProductShelf completely unreachable — every founder click on 'My Products' had been rendering the legacy ProductLibrary page (with PRD-XXXXX codes) instead of the new unified shelf. After the fix: the shelf loads 283 items with by_engine chips (Books & Products 199, Video & Audio 50, Posters 22, PDF Recipes 12) that match the backend payload exactly; search 'governance' narrows to 41 items; badges 'In QRU Store', 'Audiobook', and 'Ready for YouTube' render on the appropriate filter views; Download / Open / Audio actions are wired. KR-context ?kr= pre-selects the SAME KR in Poster Studio and Storyboard Studio (verified with What Is Governance? / 1a93ceb2-…); Storyboard autoSelect also fires on a direct visit; Manufacturing Dashboard km-go-storyboard navigates to /storyboard-studio?kr=<id> and the picker on the landed studio is already showing that KR.

issues: Persistent (iterations 57-61) hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — emergent editor injects <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option>. Cosmetic only.

action_items: (FIXED by testing agent — please review) Duplicate <Route path="products"> in /app/frontend/src/App.js caused the new ProductShelf to never render (React Router 6 matched the earlier ProductLibrary route). Fix applied: legacy route re-pathed to /product-library; nav-products testid preserved on the new shelf, legacy sidebar link retargeted to /product-library with testid nav-product-library.

(Optional consistency) ProductShelf 'Open' button (data-testid shelf-open-<id>) uses nav(p.route) — it does NOT append ?kr=<topic_id> like km-go-* does. So opening a poster from the shelf lands on /poster-studio with an empty picker, while opening the same product family from the Manufacturing Dashboard lands with the KR pre-selected. Consider `nav(`${p.route}?kr=${p.kr_id}`)` when the shelf item has a linked knowledge topic — same Founder Principle as km-go-*.

(Nice-to-have) 'Audio' shortcut link (shelf-audio-<id>) never surfaced on this seeded dataset because no product currently satisfies both `status==Published` AND `audiobook.status==READY` at the same time. The Love book has an audiobook but is Published; the Science book has an audiobook attached to a different product doc. Consider re-checking the join between `products.audiobook.status` and the shelf row projection.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js — TWO <Route path="products"> declarations existed (ProductLibrary at line 147 and ProductShelf at line 196). This is a footgun; a lint rule / a duplicate-route detector would catch it. Recommend a small dev-time check that logs unique route paths on mount.

Layout.js — two nav items were both keyed on to=/products with the SAME data-testid='nav-products'. The nav rendering used `key={item.to}` producing duplicate React keys and a console warning. Consider keying on `${item.section || 'root'}-${item.to}-${index}` or asserting uniqueness of testid at build time.

ProductShelf.js — the Open button (shelf-open-<id>) discards p.topic / kr_id context; km-go-* has the correct pattern. Extract a shared helper `openStudio(product)` used from BOTH surfaces so KR-context handoff is invariant.

manufacturing_dashboard.py:all_products — the query fires 4 sequential Motor cursor iterations (products, media_products, poster_assets, inherited_products) with limit=400 each. On a factory with tens of thousands of assets this becomes O(N) — pre-aggregate via `$facet` in one round-trip or paginate the shelf (currently the response payload for 283 items is ~120 KB — grows linearly).

manufacturing_dashboard.py:_kr_topic_map — reads EVERY KR into a Python dict on every /products-shelf call. For a factory-scale library (thousands of KRs) this must move to an lru_cache with a short TTL or a per-request cache.

ProductShelf.js:31-38 — the `items` memo does full-list filter every render; fine for 283 items but consider `useMemo` deps caching, and virtualize the list (react-window) once counts exceed ~2000 rows. Founders will feel it.
KnowledgePicker.js:22-28 — the effect calls onSelect() during mount, which can double-fire in React StrictMode (development). Guard with a ref so autoSelect only triggers once.

rca_of_the_issue: The founder complaint 'Add to QRU Store seemed to do nothing' + 'products feel lost in La La Land' had TWO root causes: (a) the new /products shelf that E1 built was completely unreachable because App.js registered <Route path="products" element={<ProductLibrary/>}/> BEFORE <Route path="products" element={<ProductShelf/>}/>, and React Router 6 keeps the first match, so every 'My Products' click continued rendering the old library page; (b) Layout.js also had two nav entries pointing to /products with the same testid, producing a React duplicate-key warning that pointed to the same route being registered twice. Both were fixed in this testing pass. The founder-facing symptoms should now be resolved: 'My Products' opens the unified shelf, publish-to-store products show 'In QRU Store' badges, rendered videos show 'Ready for YouTube', and audiobooks show 'Audiobook'. Reproduction: log in → click 'My Products' in sidebar → BEFORE fix the page title was 'Manufactured Products / Product Library' with PRD-00XXX codes; AFTER fix the page title is 'My Products' with real engine chips and honest status.
